'''Version 1.5.0''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on January 12th 2020.  It was 3.34 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

==== <u>Fixes</u> ====

* Fixed [[Rupter|Mudo]] attacking option not working
* Fixed [[Yelloweye (Disambiguation)|Emana]] shooting

==== <u>Changes</u> ====

* Changed [[Primitive Longarms|Primitive Shyco]] model
* Changed knock back resistance value for some mobs
* Changed [[Buglin|Lodo]] growl sound
* Changed Mudo animation
* [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Canra]] now has a limit of mobs
* Mob attacking option can target more mobs (if not considered Animals)

==== <u>New Content</u> ====

* Added two weapons, a [[Living Scythe|Scythe]] and a [[Living Bow|Greatbow]]
* Added a list of entities that will have the task to target the parasites
* Added the following items:
*# Living Greatbow Upper
*# Limb Living Greatbow Lower Limb
*# Living Greatbow String
*# Living Greatbow Grip
*# Living Greatbow Core
*# Living Scythe Back
*# Living Scythe Blade
*# Living Scythe Handle
*# Living Scythe Head
*# Living Scythe Core
*# [[Longarms Armor Fragment|Shyco Armor Fragment]]
*# [[Reeker Fang|Nogla Blade]]
*# [[Manducater Orb|Hull Orb]]
*# [[Yelloweye Bone|Emana Bone]]
*# [[Summoner Core|Canra Core]]
*# [[Infected Flesh]]

* Added a new primitive and Adapted mob: [[Bolster (Disambiguation)|Zetmo]]
*# This mob can buff nearby parasites and make them stronger

* Added a [[Reinforcement System]]:
*# When a parasite is killed, there is a chance for it to call reinforcements, this means that a [[Stage I Beckon|Venkrol]] will spawn nearby and will help in the fight. The Venkrol has different stages and that will tell how many and which parasites it will spawn.
